[note]Modularized machines[/note]
TST's modularized machines (Plasma Forge MK-II, Large Neutron Oscillator, Indistinct Tentacle MK-II, Mass Fabricator Genesis, Strange Matter Aggregator...) take module hatches. Execution cores run the recipes; parallel, speed, power and overclock modules change how. Place them in the hatch positions shown in the structure preview.

A faster execution core.
